# AGENTS.md — opensro-bot-lean (nixxane bot)

Compact Tampermonkey userscript bot for `https://opensro.online/play*` (combat, loot, potions, pet pickup, town trips, restocking, walk-back). It runs in the page context and observes the game's simulation worker through a worker hook. Diagnostics are exposed on `window.SROLean`. It is NOT the game client or server.

Deeper background lives in `context.md` (handoff doc, snapshot — verify against code/git), `OBSTACLE-RECOVERY.md`, and `notes/<version>.md` (release notes).

## Golden rule: edit sources, never the generated files
`bot.lean.user.js` and `bot.lean.meta.js` are GENERATED by `build-lean.py`. Edit the source modules (`lean-*.js`, `restock.js`, `lean-skin.css`, `build-lean.py`), then rebuild. `lean-wardrobe-core.js` is generated by `build-wardrobe.py`; edit the generator/input, not the output alone.
`vendor/bot.js` is the original reviewed assistant used as build input. Do NOT modify it. Build-time adaptations are string replacements in `build-lean.py` (they assert the original text exists; if an assertion fails, the vendor text changed).

## Layout (where things live)
- `lean-controller.js` coordinates hunting, restock, return, loot; `lean-boot.js` starts everything.
- `lean-loot.js` drops/pickup/pet collector; `lean-town.js` scroll town trips; `restock.js` merchant routes; `lean-walkback.js` return to hunt spot.
- `lean-navigation.js`, `lean-pursuit-navigation.js`, `lean-chase.js`, `lean-trap.js`, `lean-antistuck.js` movement/obstacle logic.
- `lean-settings.js` defaults + per-character persistence; `lean-ui.js` panel (open shadow root `#sro-bot-lean`); `lean-stats.js` session stats.
- `lean-reconnect.js`, `lean-session.js` reconnect/login recovery; `lean-autostart.js` optional start on entering the game; `lean-party.js`, `lean-resurrect.js`, `lean-alchemy.js`, `lean-speed-scroll.js`, `lean-support.js`/`lean-reports.js` reports.
- Tests: `lean.test.cjs` (main integration suite, loads the generated script into a `vm` context), `lean.obstacle.test.cjs`, `lean.logging.test.cjs`, `lean.session.test.cjs`, `lean.browser.test.cjs` (Playwright + Edge), `lean.navigation.native.test.mjs` (needs an OpenSRO checkout).

## Commands (run from repo root)
```bash
python3 build-lean.py            # regenerate bot.lean.user.js + bot.lean.meta.js (runs build-wardrobe.py first)
node --check bot.lean.user.js    # syntax check
node lean.test.cjs               # integration tests (includes lean.obstacle.test.cjs fixtures)
git diff --check                 # whitespace/EOL problems
```
`lean.browser.test.cjs <dir-containing-playwright>` needs Playwright + Edge and is Windows-oriented; skip it unless asked. Never use the user's browser profile or live account; tests use simulated game state.
Always rebuild before running tests, because tests read the generated `bot.lean.user.js`.

## How to work
1. Read the relevant module, its callers and its tests first. Check `git status` and preserve unrelated changes.
2. For a bug: write a regression test that fails on the current build, explain the confirmed cause, then fix it in the source module. For a feature: add tests with it.
3. Keep the bot lean. No broad rewrites; do not bring back full-assistant panels (chat, GM tools, radar, etc.).
4. Keep independent services independent: pet pickup must not pause combat; party automation must not depend on hunting. Keep manual controls and lifecycle resets working.
5. Test state-machine failure paths: missing state, pending transactions, expiry, duplicate commands, disconnect/reset, feature disabled.
6. Prefer verified game contracts over guessed command names/fields. The game source (if available at `../opensro`, under `apps/client-next/src/engine`) is READ-ONLY reference. Never modify it, and read its own `AGENTS.md` before looking.
7. Be honest about evidence: passing mocked/simulated tests is not live-server verification. Say what was and was not exercised.
8. UI labels and progress messages: plain English, short.

## Behaviour that must be preserved
- Pickup success requires a matching inventory/gold gain; despawn alone is not success.
- Pet collector has no character fallback; broad native auto-grab stays disabled; require server confirmation before selective pickup. Pets collect alongside combat.
- Loot ownership, exclusion and capacity checks apply even to name-included items.
- Obstacle recovery: unknown coverage or search exhaustion alone must never ban/stop a target; a detour owns movement until done or released (see `OBSTACLE-RECOVERY.md`). No teleporting, pose resets or collision bypass.
- Never press the game's Confirm button on the "session ended" window (it logs the user out).
- Settings are per character, stored under prefix `sroBotLean:v1:`; don't change the prefix or break saved settings without a migration.

## Code style
Plain JavaScript (no bundler, no package.json), LF line endings, match the surrounding module's idiom and comment density. Python files: read/write with explicit `encoding='utf-8'`. Never edit sources with shell redirection that could change encoding or EOLs.

## Releases
Merged PRs are released automatically by `.github/workflows/release.yml` (next patch version, notes, build, tests, GitHub release, Discord; the website entry only when the `SITE_TOKEN` secret is set). PR reviews, the review-fix-merge job and the release notes run Claude Code on DeepSeek (`deepseek-flash`); issue fixes run on Claude. Do not release a merged PR by hand as well. By hand, only when the user asks:
1. Bump BOTH version strings in `build-lean.py` (userscript `@version` and runtime `VERSION`). Versions are integer `major.minor.patch` (1.2.11 is newer than 1.2.9). Never reuse a published version for changed behaviour.
2. Add `notes/<version>.md` (short, plain language; state what was only tested in simulation).
3. Run build, `node --check`, `node lean.test.cjs`, `git diff --check`. Confirm both generated headers and runtime `VERSION` agree.
4. Commit source, tests, docs AND both generated files together with explicit `git add <paths>` (never `git add -A`).
5. Do NOT push unless the user says to. Documentation-only changes need no version bump or rebuild.

## Never
- Commit browser profiles (`browser-test-profile/`), screenshots (`lean-*.png`), `*settings.json`, `.env*`, `*.before-*.js` backups, or personal data.
- Edit `vendor/bot.js` or hand-edit the generated userscript.
- Connect to a live account or the user's real browser profile without explicit authorization.
- Spawn extra work in unrelated repos.

## Delegation (OpenCode)
- Use `@explore` for any search that spans more than 2–3 files (e.g. "who calls X", "where is setting Y used").
- Run `@review` on the diff before reporting a task done; fix real findings.
